newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread calls halt to big spending spree.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread calls halt to big spending spree.

text.p: Brewer to leisure group Whitbread Plc is entering a period of smaller acquisitions and organic growth after a string of major acquisitions over the last two years, said David Richardson, strategic planning director.
"Going forward we are more likely to see opportunistic acquisitions than big strategic throws," said Richardson in an interview with RFTV.
In the last two years Whitbread has spent some 600 million pounds on acquisitions that include Britain's Marriott hotel chain, David Lloyd sports clubs and the Pelican group of restaurants.
Richardson said the company's most recent acquisition of BrightReasons -- owners of 180 pizza and pasta restaurants -- for 46 million pounds was more characteristic of its future acquisitions policy.
